summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing its summary 1H 2026 Business Report, submitted to Korean regulators under the Financial Investment Services and Capital Market Act. The report covers standard items such as business results, corporate governance, major shareholders, directors, related-party transactions, and internal control. It is a routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate action is announced. The filing includes consolidated and separate review reports for 1H 2026. What to watch: no special-situation angle; monitor future disclosures for any strategic initiatives.
